title: Speaking — Keeping fit
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on keeping fit.

questions: Which season do you most look forward to?
Does the time of year affect what you wear?
What do you like doing in cooler weather?
Has the weather in your area changed since you were a child?
Which activities help you stay active?
Does weather affect how much exercise you get?

part2.topic: Describe a physical activity you tried for the first time.
part2.closing: and explain whether you would encourage someone else to try it.

questions: How can employers help people who spend much of the day sitting?
What stops some communities from using public sports facilities?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to keeping fit?
